name: codex-control
description: Remote mobile control bridge for local Codex tasks.
author: g826796047

scripts.dev: pnpm build && concurrently -k -n web,desktop -c cyan,green "pnpm --filter @codex-control/web dev" "pnpm --filter @codex-control/desktop dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @codex-control/shared build && pnpm --filter @codex-control/web build && pnpm --filter @codex-control/server build && pnpm --filter @codex-control/desktop build
